notes: Legacy Furman "Series II" power conditioner (predecessor to the current PL-8C); no longer sold new by Furman but well documented via the official owner's manual (mirrored on ManualsLib) and retailer/marketplace listings (Musician's Friend, Reverb, Equipboard). It is a pure AC power-conditioning/rack-light unit with no audio/video/data signal I/O. Outlets are the standard US grounded duplex type; the manual does not print the literal "NEMA 5-15R" designation but this is the universal connector for 15A/120V duplex outlets in this Furman product class (confirmed by name for the closely related PL-Plus II). The power cord is a captive/hardwired 10 ft, 14 AWG cord (not a detachable IEC inlet), so it is modeled here as a NEMA 5-15 male-plug input rather than an IEC appliance inlet. The rear BNC jack is a 12VAC/0.5A gooseneck-lamp accessory power output, not a data/video signal port, so no bandwidth grade applies. Two front-panel retractable LED light fixtures and a front circuit breaker are present but are not connector ports. Rated 15A, 120VAC, 60Hz; 1U rackmount, 19" W x 10.5" D x 1.75" H.
